examples.text: Seine Augen schauen nervös umher, er gestikuliert wild, wirkt unruhig. (...) Der 56-Jährige, der sonst wie ein unbeweglicher Stein dasitzt, klingt flehentlich, während er spricht.
examples.translation: Ses yeux regardent nerveusement autour de lui, il gesticule frénétiquement, semble agité. (...) L’homme de 56 ans, habituellement assis comme une pierre immobile, a un ton suppliant lorsqu’il parle.

examples.text: A "Haka" is the native dance, answering to the corroboree of the Australian aboriginals, and we were anxious to see it. The performers, all male, stood in a row, one, slightly advanced, acting as fugleman. They shouted and gesticulated with the most hideous and revolting gestures, grimaces, and yells.
... groups of dancers were wheeling, plunging, and gesticulating while the ogre, more aphasic than before, mumbled at full strength ...
